q: In Ephesians, Paul says we have been saved by what, through faith?
quote: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith

q: In Ephesians, Paul says being saved by grace is not from ourselves, but is what?
quote: and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God

q: In Ephesians, Paul says we are not saved by works, so that no one can do what?
why: All the credit goes to God.
quote: not by works, so that no one can boast.

q: In Ephesians, Paul says God, because of His great love, is rich in what?
why: He made us alive with Christ.
quote: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy

q: In Ephesians, Paul says God made us alive with Christ even when we were what?
why: God gives life to the lost.
quote: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses.

q: In Ephesians, Paul says we are God's workmanship, created in Christ to do what?
quote: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works

q: In Ephesians, Paul says believers are no longer strangers, but members of whose household?
why: Grace brings us into God's family.
quote: but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household

q: In Ephesians, what does Paul tell believers to put on to stand against the devil?
why: God gives us what we need to stand.
quote: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.

q: In the armor of God, what is the belt buckled around the waist?
quote: with the belt of truth buckled around your waist

q: In the armor of God, what is the breastplate?
quote: with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed

q: In the armor of God, which shield puts out the evil one's flaming arrows?
quote: take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

q: In the armor of God, what is the helmet?
quote: And take the helmet of salvation

q: In the armor of God, what is the sword of the Spirit?
quote: and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

q: In the armor of God, what are our feet fitted with?
why: We are ready to share good news.
quote: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

q: When Paul describes the armor of God, he says our struggle is not against what?
quote: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood

q: In Ephesians, Paul says to be strong in what?
quote: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

q: After describing God's armor, how often does Paul tell believers to pray in the Spirit?
quote: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition.

q: In Ephesians, Paul says to forgive each other just as who forgave you?
quote: forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

q: In Ephesians, Paul says do not let what set upon your anger?
quote: Do not let the sun set upon your anger

q: In Ephesians, what does Paul tell children to do?
why: This is right in the Lord.
quote: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

q: In Ephesians, Paul calls “Honor your father and mother” the first commandment with what?
quote: (which is the first commandment with a promise)

q: In Ephesians, Paul tells believers to be imitators of whom?
quote: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children

q: In Ephesians, who is called the cornerstone of God's household?
why: The church is built on Him.
quote: with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.

q: In Ephesians, Paul lists one Lord, one faith, and one what?
quote: one Lord, one faith, one baptism

q: To the saints in which city did Paul write the letter of Ephesians?
why: He was an apostle by God's will.
quote: To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus

q: In Ephesians, whom did Paul send to tell the believers all his news?
quote: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything

q: In Ephesians, Paul says God is able to do much more than all we what?
quote: to do so much more than all we ask or imagine

q: In Ephesians, Paul says speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and what?
why: Make music to the Lord in your hearts.
quote: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs.

q: In Ephesians, Paul urges believers to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of what?
quote: to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
